evals.prompt: Convert this transparent white logo to SVG. Preserve its current background and original colors.
evals.expected_output: Convert with preserve, keep white foreground, render against light/dark matte; never globally remove white.

Inspect, announce source-preserving default, and explicitly pass preserve. Do not automatically remove the white background or ask a mandatory retention question; pause if actual fidelity problems are detected.

evals.prompt: Remove only the outside white background and convert to SVG; enclosed white details belong to the logo.
evals.expected_output: Use edge-connected removal after inspecting; preserve enclosed white and the red foreground; validate colors and alpha.

evals.prompt: Convert this transparent red icon to SVG; preserve the original color.
evals.expected_output: Keep red unchanged; no white normalization; actual render must preserve color.

evals.prompt: Convert this gradient-backed artwork to a small editable SVG.
evals.expected_output: Identify gradient/complex input and ask about reconstruction/source artwork; do not produce many flat paths or claim recovery.

evals.prompt: Convert this logo, but ask before choosing any unspecified visual option.
evals.expected_output: Honor the explicit request: inspect and ask preserve/remove if unresolved. Defaults never override user instructions.

evals.prompt: The native question tool was called for the background decision, but I have not answered yet.
evals.expected_output: Keep conversion pending and the task waiting. Do not send final_answer, close/end the task, install tools, trace or deliver an SVG. A successful or immediate asynchronous call is not consent.

evals.prompt: The native prompt was cancelled or closed before any answer was submitted. No background mode has been chosen.
evals.expected_output: Do not select the recommendation or convert. Respect explicit cancellation/stop without reopening repeatedly; recover a failed or invisible prompt with a visible unanswered question. Reuse prior answers, and resume only if a later user message actually resolves the background decision.
